title: Assigned role required on every backlog item
description: Make the owner_role field (which serves as the assigned role) mandatory in practice, not just in schema. Update the project-next-pick script to skip any backlog item where owner_role is missing or empty. Log a warning to stderr for skipped items. This ensures every item in the scheduling pipeline has a clear role assignment.
stop_condition: The picker skips backlog items without an assigned role. A warning is emitted to stderr for each skipped item.
